caption: What Ordinance DS does not contain

rows.why: The build writes plain files. Any web server can serve them.
rows.you: Use the server that your organisation already trusts.

rows.why: A browser cannot protect a page. Protection belongs on the server.
rows.you: Put access control in front of the pages.

rows.why: A gateway needs sign-in, limits, secrets and a record of every call.
rows.you: Connect your own gateway. The page Data lists what it must do.

rows.why: The stylesheet styles plain HTML, so a page works without one.
rows.you: Add one in your product if you need it.

rows.why: Only the page Data loads a script. Every other page works without one.
rows.you: Add a script as a file in a plugin that has the permission.

rows.what: Hiding items of the menu for a plan or a role
rows.why: Hiding in the browser protects nothing, and it can look like access control.
rows.you: Decide on the server what a reader may open.
